title: deskcrit gate
description: The JSON document that crit gate --json writes (docs/PRD.md section 8.3, FR-40, FR-41). It is a report with mode gate and one more field, gate. Every report field is a $ref to schemas/report.schema.json, so the two shapes cannot drift apart; a validator must load report.schema.json under the id report.schema.json. Written for JSON Schema draft 2020-12; the $schema keyword is left out by project rule. Unknown fields are rejected, as in the report schema.

gate.description: The gate decision (section 8.3). The exit code agrees with passed: 0 when true, 1 when false.

passed.description: True when no finding blocks the gate (FR-40).

policy.description: The gate policy as it was applied, including when the default was used (FR-41).

warn_fails_gate.description: True when warn verdicts fail the gate as well as fail verdicts (FR-41).

blocking.description: The criterion ids whose findings caused the failure, in finding order. Empty when passed is true.

then.description: A gate that passed has nothing blocking it.

else.description: A gate that failed names at least one blocking criterion.
